# Drew Nagda

> Drew Nagda is a distressed real estate developer, investor, and technologist based in Pasadena, California. He is the founder of Nagda Homes, a vertically integrated real estate company that has bought, rebuilt, and sold more than 300 homes across Southern California since 2016.

Canonical site: https://www.drewnagda.com
Definitive bio page (short, medium, long): https://www.drewnagda.com/about
Person entity: https://www.drewnagda.com/#person
Company entity: https://www.drewnagda.com/#nagda-homes
Contact: drew@drewnagda.com

## Who this site belongs to

- Name: Drew Nagda
- Role: Founder, Nagda Homes. Distressed real estate developer, investor, technologist.
- Location: Pasadena, California (born and raised in Ocala, Florida)
- Education: Indiana University, business. Started his first company there, B-Town Tutors, a campus tutoring service.
- Family: wife Thalia Nagda, son Ezra Nagda (born 2024)
- Motto: Todo es posible. Family and loyalty over everything.

## Nagda Homes

- Founded 2016, started with one distressed property in the Inland Empire.
- More than 300 homes bought, rebuilt, and sold across Southern California.
- Vertically integrated: acquisition, construction, design, sales, and property management all in-house.
- Focus: heavy value add, ADU development, fire-damage restoration.
- Buys distressed homes direct from owners; also probate. Closes fast, as-is.
- In-house construction crews. Thalia Nagda is the designer, a licensed real estate agent, and the property manager.
- Areas: Pasadena, Inland Empire, Los Angeles County, San Bernardino County, Riverside County.

## Before real estate (New York City, 2010 to 2016)

- SinglePlatform: early employee. The company sold to Constant Contact for $100 million.
- Rap Genius (now Genius): early team member and executive editor.
- Lean Startup Machine: ran partnerships and helped scale the workshops to 6 continents.
- Techstars: 2013.
- Rancho Humilde: special projects for the independent label that helped bring corridos tumbados to the mainstream.
- On Deck: participated in On Deck NYC.

## Now

- Angel investor.
- Recently co-hosted the Latino Entrepreneur Summit.
- Host of World Cup Eats with his son Ezra, a father-son food series visiting a Los Angeles restaurant for every country in the 2026 World Cup. https://worldcupeats.com
- Building Puro Raza, song lyrics for música mexicana explained line by line in Spanish and English. https://puroraza.com
- Building Fountain of Youth, dead serious water fountain reviews where every rating is secretly a life lesson. https://ratemyfountain.com
- Selling a distressed property in Southern California: email drew@drewnagda.com with the address and photos.

## Places

- Ocala, FL: born and raised
- Bloomington, IN: 2006 to 2010, Indiana University, B-Town Tutors
- New York City and Brooklyn: 2010 to 2016
- Upland, CA: 2016 to 2023, scaling Nagda Homes
- Pasadena, CA: 2023 to now
